svg.title: Memory allocated per decode call, relative to @mapbox/polyline
svg.desc: Heap plus typed arrays and WASM memory, divided by @mapbox/polyline's at the same size, log scale. Down is less memory. polytini 0.1.0, default import. Median of 3 rounds in fresh processes, 2026-11-26. Bun isn't measured (see docs/methodology.md). Groups are points per line. Node 24.22.3: 100 points: polytini 0.1.0 0.84x, @googlemaps/polyline-codec 0.85x, google-polyline 0.97x, @placemarkio/polyline 0.99x, @pirxpilot/google-polyline 1.04x; 10k points: polytini 0.1.0 0.85x, @googlemaps/polyline-codec 0.85x, google-polyline 1.00x, @placemarkio/polyline 1.00x, @pirxpilot/google-polyline 1.00x; 100k points: polytini 0.1.0 0.81x, @googlemaps/polyline-codec 0.82x, google-polyline 1.00x, @placemarkio/polyline 1.00x, @pirxpilot/google-polyline 1.00x. Deno 2.5.4: 100 points: polytini 0.1.0 0.87x, @googlemaps/polyline-codec 0.83x, google-polyline 0.99x, @placemarkio/polyline 1.00x, @pirxpilot/google-polyline 1.03x; 10k points: polytini 0.1.0 0.85x, @googlemaps/polyline-codec 0.85x, google-polyline 1.00x, @placemarkio/polyline 1.00x, @pirxpilot/google-polyline 1.00x; 100k points: polytini 0.1.0 0.79x, @googlemaps/polyline-codec 0.82x, google-polyline 1.00x, @placemarkio/polyline 1.00x, @pirxpilot/google-polyline 1.00x.
